text:
alex (eng-manager): Hey team — Priya starts Monday in Platform Eng. Can someone drop the manager/HR first-week checklist and a 30/60/90 template? :wave:
megan (people-ops): Welcome Priya! :tada: Alex — posted the canonical checklist in #people-ops-docs but pasting quick hits here:
megan (people-ops): - Day 0: laptop + VPN + KMS access requested
megan (people-ops): - Day 1: HR intro (benefits, payroll), security training, and account provisioning
megan (people-ops): - Week 1: team 1:1s, mentor pairing, first small task, office tour (if onsite)
megan (people-ops): - By EOW: confirm dev environment, deploy access, and 1st-week goals
megan (people-ops): Also link to 30/60/90 template: https://intranet.redwood/people/30-60-90-template
jordan (infra): I'll handle infra access. Expect these invites from me:
jordan (infra): - infra-setup (30m) to SSH into build machines
jordan (infra): - kv-cache walkthrough (45m) with @sasha
jordan (infra): If you need faster GPU access for local testing, DM me — can pre-allocate a slot.
sasha (mentor): I'll book our recurring 1:1s (Mon/Wed, 30m) and a shadowing block on Wed afternoon. I'll add a checklist item: pair on an internal bug triage.
people_ops_bot: Onboarding task created: ONB-4827 for priya@redwood — Due: 2024-04-05. Assigned: megan (people-ops)
alex (eng-manager): Thanks — quick question about expectations: what's reasonable for Priya's 30/60/90 in Platform Eng?
megan (people-ops): High level we ask managers to set success markers. Quick example we use internally:
megan (people-ops): ```
30d: fully bootstrapped local dev, merged first tiny fix, finished security & infra trainings
60d: owned a small feature or infra improvement end-to-end, contributed to on-call runbook
90d: delivered measurable perf improvement or cost-saving change, mentor a new hire
```
alex (eng-manager): Perfect. I'll draft a tailored 30/60/90 and share before EOD Friday.
priya (new-hire): Thanks everyone — super excited! Quick Q: who do I ping about signing the laptop receipt?
megan (people-ops): Ping me here or send to people-ops@redwood, I'll confirm pickup time. :+1:
jordan (infra): Also FYI — run this once you have VPN: `./scripts/setup_env.sh && make deps` — should take ~10m.
sasha (mentor): FYI I'll drop a small starter issue in the sprint board labeled "new-hire: low-risk" for Priya to pick.
alex (eng-manager): Awesome. If anyone sees anything missing in the checklist DM me. Let's aim to make week 1 feel structured but not overwhelming. :rocket:
